sese_check: Runs 'sese_check' via analyzer:check_sese. Records: sese/verified.

build_replay: Runs 'build_replay' via builder:/v1/build. Records: build/replay. Requires: sese/verified = pass for this region.

run_replay: Runs 'run_replay' via builder:/v1/run. Records: gpu/executed. Requires: build/replay = pass for the submitted tree.

sanitize: Runs 'sanitize' via builder:/v1/sanitize. Records: sanitize/memcheck, sanitize/racecheck, sanitize/initcheck. Requires: gpu/executed = pass for the submitted tree.

regression_visible: Runs 'regression_visible' via oracle:/v1/compare. Records: regression/visible. Requires: sanitize/memcheck = pass for the submitted tree; sanitize/racecheck = pass for the submitted tree.

property_check: Runs 'property_check' via builder:/v1/properties. Records: regression/property. Requires: regression/visible = pass for the submitted tree. Optional settings: seed (integer) -- The Hypothesis seed for the search. One is drawn for the run when left out, and the claim records which. max_examples (integer) -- How many examples to draw per property. A hundred when left out.

regression_holdout: Runs 'regression_holdout' via oracle:/v1/compare. Records: regression/holdout. Requires: regression/visible = pass for the submitted tree.

program_regression: Runs 'program_regression' via builder:/v1/time. Records: program/regression. Requires: regression/holdout = pass for the submitted tree.

time_port: Runs 'time_port' via builder:/v1/time. Records: timing/port. Requires: program/regression = pass for the submitted tree. Optional settings: repeats (integer) -- How many timed runs to make. Five when left out.

time_baseline: Runs 'time_baseline' via builder:/v1/time. Records: timing/baseline. Optional settings: repeats (integer) -- How many timed runs to make. Five when left out.
